patch_description: This constructor replaces the single structured local optimization with a deterministic multistart contact-graph search. It generates many staggered/hexagonal-like seeds with controlled asymmetry, then solves the exact nonlinear packing problem using analytic gradients for squared pair-separation constraints. Different row layouts and perturbations help escape the symmetric 2.50-radius local optimum. The best feasible result is polished and conservatively rescaled to guarantee containment and non-overlap after floating-point rounding.
